name: Cheela Shop
description: A small storefront selling well-made everyday goods — audio, bags, footwear, home and tech.

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.addresses-list
capabilities.description: List the shopper's saved delivery addresses. Requires a signed-in shopper. Call this before placing an order so you can offer their saved addresses instead of asking them to dictate one — pass the chosen addressId to checkout-place-order.

label.description: What the shopper calls it, e.g. "Home"

summary.description: The address on one line, safe to read back

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.cart-add-item
capabilities.description: Add a product to the cart. Omit cartId to start a new cart — the id comes back in the result, and every later cart call needs it. Stock is enforced, so this fails if the requested quantity exceeds what is available.

cartId.description: Omit to create a new cart

itemId.description: Use this to update or remove the line

freeShippingRemaining.description: Spend this much more for free shipping; null once qualified

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.cart-clear
capabilities.description: Empty the cart without placing an order.

cartId.description: Omit for a signed-in shopper — their own cart is used

itemId.description: Use this to update or remove the line

freeShippingRemaining.description: Spend this much more for free shipping; null once qualified

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.cart-remove-item
capabilities.description: Remove a line from the cart entirely.

cartId.description: Omit for a signed-in shopper — their own cart is used

itemId.description: The itemId from a cart result
Use this to update or remove the line

freeShippingRemaining.description: Spend this much more for free shipping; null once qualified

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.cart-update-item
capabilities.description: Change the quantity of a line already in the cart. Setting quantity to 0 removes it.

cartId.description: Omit for a signed-in shopper — their own cart is used

itemId.description: The itemId from a cart result, not the product id
Use this to update or remove the line

freeShippingRemaining.description: Spend this much more for free shipping; null once qualified

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.cart-view
capabilities.description: Show the current contents and totals of a cart.

cartId.description: Omit for a signed-in shopper — their own cart is used automatically

itemId.description: Use this to update or remove the line

freeShippingRemaining.description: Spend this much more for free shipping; null once qualified

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.catalog-get-product
capabilities.description: Full detail for one product: description, specifications, stock level and related items. Call this before adding something to the cart if the shopper asked about specifics.

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.catalog-list-categories
capabilities.description: List every product category with how many products it holds.

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.catalog-search-products
capabilities.description: Search and filter the product catalogue. Use this for any question about what is for sale, what is available in a category, what is on sale, or what fits a budget.

query.description: Free-text search over name, tagline, description and tags

total.description: Total matches, not just this page

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.checkout-pay-order
capabilities.description: Get a secure payment link for an order the shopper already placed. Requires a signed-in shopper, and only works on their own orders. Payment happens on Razorpay's own page — give the shopper the paymentUrl and ask them to open it. You cannot complete the payment yourself, and you must never ask for card, UPI or bank details. Check back with orders-get-order to see whether it went through.

paymentMethod.description: Ignored — the shopper chooses how to pay on the Razorpay page.

paid.description: True only once payment has been captured

declineReason.description: Why the payment failed, when paid is false

paymentUrl.description: Give this to the shopper to open and pay. Null when payment is already settled.

instruction.description: What to tell the shopper next

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.checkout-place-order
capabilities.description: Place the order for a cart. Requires a signed-in shopper. This reserves stock and empties the cart, but does NOT take payment — the order comes back as pending_payment and you must then call checkout-pay-order. Confirm the items and the total with the shopper first, and never invent an address: ask for one.

cartId.description: Omit to use the shopper's current cart

addressId.description: A saved address from addresses-list. Prefer this — ask the shopper which saved address to use rather than collecting one field by field. When set, every address field below is ignored.

name.description: Recipient name; defaults to the signed-in shopper's name

email.description: Where the receipt goes; defaults to the signed-in shopper's email

paid.description: True only once payment has been captured

nextStep.description: What has to happen before the order is complete

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.orders-get-order
capabilities.description: Look up one of the shopper's own orders by number, including its payment status. Requires a signed-in shopper.

paid.description: True only once payment has been captured

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.orders-list
capabilities.description: List the signed-in shopper's order history, newest first. Use this for "where is my order", "what did I buy" or "did that payment go through".

paid.description: True only once payment has been captured

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.store-get-policies
capabilities.description: Shipping, tax, returns and guarantee terms. Use this to answer "how much is shipping", "when will it arrive" or "can I return it" rather than guessing.

capabilities.name: com.cheelalabs.demo-shop.store-list-payment-methods
capabilities.description: List the payment method tokens checkout-pay-order accepts. Call this before paying so you pass a valid token. This is a demo store: these are simulated methods, no real card is ever charged, and you must never ask the shopper for real card details.
